_comment: GENERATED by scripts/burst_model_hashes.py — do not hand-edit.
SHA-256 of each InsightFace .onnx baked into the worker image. This
is the parity contract: the Docker build FAILS on mismatch, and
India's health gate asserts the same hashes against a live Pod
These came from the models that BUILT THE LIVE FAISS INDEX, which is
why they are authoritative. Regenerating them from a different
machine, or from whatever the build downloads, defeats the check.
Re-run the script on the production server if the models change.
